shared_elements: round-topped stele with carved relief field
winged sun-disc / outstretched winged motif across the upper lunette
human figures in profile facing one another
offering table or altar between figures
seated/standing figures with raised arms in gesture of offering or adoration
deity figure with animal (falcon-like) head wearing a disc
justification: Both are round-topped stelae whose lunette carries an outstretched winged disc, below which profile human figures face one another across an offering stand, accompanied by columns/lines of the same script-like signs. The chief difference is that A packs many small figures into three or four crowded registers of a funerary banquet/mourning type, while B shows a single large two-figure adoration scene with a falcon-headed deity and an empty lower panel.
